  - text: CLASS 12 • THREE-DIMENSIONAL GEOMETRY
  - heading "Intercept Form of a Plane" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Interact with the intercepts below. Move the sliders or drag the handles on the axes to see how the plane changes.
  - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT geometry3d
  - main:
    - article:
      - heading "3D INTERCEPT EXPLORER" [level=3]
      - text: Intercept form x/4 + y/3 + z/2 = 1 ↔ Standard form 3x + 4y + 6z = 12
      - img "Plane through three coordinate-axis intercepts": A (4, 0, 0) B (0, 3, 0) C (0, 0, 2)
      - checkbox "Show axes" [checked]
      - text: Show axes
      - checkbox "Show plane" [checked]
      - text: Show plane
      - checkbox "Show traces" [checked]
      - text: Show traces
      - checkbox "Show tetrahedron" [checked]
      - text: Show tetrahedron
      - button "Rotate view"
      - button "Reset view":
        - img
        - text: Reset view
    - complementary:
      - heading "INTERCEPT CONTROLS" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Drag sliders or axis handles to change intercepts.
      - article:
        - text: a (x-intercept)
        - slider "a intercept slider": "4"
        - strong: "4"
        - button "Decrease a":
          - img
        - button "Increase a":
          - img
      - article:
        - text: b (y-intercept)
        - slider "b intercept slider": "3"
        - strong: "3"
        - button "Decrease b":
          - img
        - button "Increase b":
          - img
      - article:
        - text: c (z-intercept)
        - slider "c intercept slider": "2"
        - strong: "2"
        - button "Decrease c":
          - img
        - button "Increase c":
          - img
      - text: Quick presets
      - button "(4, 3, 2)"
      - button "(6, 4, 3)"
      - button "(3, 3, 3)"
      - button "(∞, 3, 2)"
      - button "Reset all":
        - img
        - text: Reset all
      - heading "TETRAHEDRON ENRICHMENT" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The plane with the coordinate planes forms a tetrahedron.
      - strong: Volume = |abc|/6 = 4
      - text: 4 cubic units
    - article:
      - heading "INTERCEPT TABLE" [level=3]
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "x-axis a=4 (4,0,0)":
            - cell "x-axis"
            - cell "a=4"
            - cell "(4,0,0)"
          - row "y-axis b=3 (0,3,0)":
            - cell "y-axis"
            - cell "b=3"
            - cell "(0,3,0)"
          - row "z-axis c=2 (0,0,2)":
            - cell "z-axis"
            - cell "c=2"
            - cell "(0,0,2)"
      - paragraph: "General intercept form: x/4 + y/3 + z/2 = 1"
      - paragraph: "Standard form: 3x + 4y + 6z = 12"
    - article:
      - heading "TRACES ON COORDINATE PLANES" [level=3]
      - text: xy-plane (z=0) x/4 + y/3 = 1 xz-plane (y=0) x/4 + z/2 = 1 yz-plane (x=0) y/3 + z/2 = 1
    - article:
      - heading "INTERACTIONS & SPECIAL CASES" [level=3]
      - paragraph: If an intercept is zero, intercept form is invalid; the editor clamps finite intercepts away from zero.
      - paragraph: If an intercept is infinite, its term vanishes and the plane is parallel to that axis.
    - article:
      - heading "COMMON PITFALL" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Do not confuse denominators with coefficients.
      - text: x/4+y/3+z/2=1 is not 4x+3y+2z=1.
      - paragraph: Its standard form is 3x+4y+6z=12.
    - article:
      - heading "VECTOR & GEOMETRIC VIEW" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Intercept points A(4,0,0), B(0,3,0), C(0,0,2).
      - paragraph: Normal vector n=(3,4,6).
      - paragraph: Triangle area=7.81; distance from origin=1.536.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "For a=6, b=-3, c=2: x/6-y/3+z/2=1."
      - paragraph: Multiply by 6 to obtain x-2y+3z=6.
      - paragraph: Check all three intercept points by substitution.
    - article:
      - heading "PRACTICE" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: a=2,b=5,c=10
        - listitem: A(3,0,0), B(0,4,0), C(0,0,6)
        - listitem: a=-4,b=6,c=-3
        - listitem: Parallel to yz-plane through (0,0,5)
      - button "Show solutions":
        - img
        - text: Show solutions
    - heading "IMPORTANT FORMULAE & CHECKS" [level=3]
    - text: Intercept form x/a+y/b+z/c=1 Standard form 3x + 4y + 6z = 12 Normal vector (3,4,6) Distance from origin 1.536 Volume 4
